title: Article 120 — Language to be used in Parliament

content.overview: Article 120 provides that business in Parliament shall be transacted in Hindi or in English, subject to Article 348 (language of the Supreme Court and High Courts / authoritative texts). A member who cannot adequately express himself in Hindi or in English may, with the permission of the Chairman or the Speaker, address the House in his mother tongue. Unless Parliament by law otherwise provides, after fifteen years from commencement the English-language option was to end — but Parliament has by law continued the use of English.
content.glance: Parliament business: Hindi or English. Member may use mother tongue with permission of Chair. English continued by parliamentary law beyond original 15-year period.
content.study:
Article 120 sets the languages of parliamentary business (Hindi or English), with a permission-based mother-tongue option for members who cannot adequately use those languages. The original 15-year sunset for English was displaced by parliamentary legislation continuing English.

Examination: Hindi/English; mother-tongue with permission; English continued by law; link Art 348 for authoritative texts.

sections.heading: Key rules
sections.body:
1. Business in Hindi or English (subject to Art 348).
2. Mother tongue with permission of Chairman/Speaker if member cannot adequately use Hindi/English.
3. English continued beyond original 15-year period by parliamentary law.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What languages may be used in Parliament under Article 120?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Under Article 120, business in Parliament is transacted in Hindi or in English. A member who cannot adequately express himself in Hindi or in English may, with the permission of the Chairman or the Speaker, address the House in his mother tongue. Parliament has by law continued the use of English beyond the original fifteen-year period from commencement.

keyTakeaways: Art 120: Hindi/English; mother tongue with permission; English continued by law.
